examples.original: [clean] Check common object locations systematically, starting with the most likely (e.g., fridge, countertop, diningtable).
examples.control: [clean] Add slow-release organic fertilizer (blood, fish and bone) to hungry crops at planting time.

examples.original: [clean] Clean the object using a sinkbasin as soon as it is obtained.
